import unittest,tempfile,pathlib,json,sys
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
import analyze
class TestMeasurement(unittest.TestCase):
 def test_exact_measurement(self):
  with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as t:
   p=pathlib.Path(t)
   (p/'signal_context.json').write_text(json.dumps({'intersection_polygon_xy_m':[[-7,-7],[7,-7],[7,7],[-7,7]],'reference_line_x_m':-11}))
   rows=[{'frame':i,'time_s':i*.05,'states':{'ego':{'body_vertices_m':[[x,0,0],[x+1,1,1]],'speed_mps':0 if i==0 else 4}}} for i,x in enumerate([-15,-5])]
   (p/'interaction_history.jsonl').write_text(''.join(json.dumps(r)+'\n' for r in rows))
   self.assertTrue(analyze.stop_before_entry(p)['sampled_halt_precedes_entry'])
   rows[0]['states']['ego']['speed_mps']=4
   (p/'interaction_history.jsonl').write_text(''.join(json.dumps(r)+'\n' for r in rows))
   self.assertFalse(analyze.stop_before_entry(p)['sampled_halt_precedes_entry'])

 def test_nearest_clear(self):
  with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as t:
   p=pathlib.Path(t)
   r={'frame':1,'time_s':.05,'sight_ray':{'hits':[{}],'eye_m':[-12,0,1.5]},'sight_candidates':[{'eye_m':[-12,0,1.5],'hit_count':1,'clear':False,'distance_to_intersection_m':5},{'eye_m':[-9,0,1.5],'hit_count':0,'clear':True,'distance_to_intersection_m':2},{'eye_m':[-8,0,1.5],'hit_count':0,'clear':True,'distance_to_intersection_m':1}]}
   (p/'interaction_history.jsonl').write_text(json.dumps(r)+'\n')
   self.assertEqual(analyze.sight_obstruction(p)['nearest_sampled_clear_point']['eye_m'][0],-8)

 def test_actual_authored_reference_geometry(self):
  import runner,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
  cfg=json.loads(pathlib.Path(runner.ROOT/'config.json').read_text());cfg['reference_kind']='unmarked_crosswalk'
  tree=ET.fromstring(runner.authored_scene(cfg))
  self.assertGreaterEqual(len(tree.findall('.//lane[@type="sidewalk"]')),8)
  self.assertFalse(tree.findall('.//object[@name="StopLine"]'))
  cfg['installed_heads']=False
  self.assertFalse(ET.fromstring(runner.authored_scene(cfg)).findall('.//signal'))

"""Physical rendered white road-marking mesh construction with paint-like collision response, not a debug overlay.

Installed traffic-line mesh tiles form a contiguous authored stop line. Native
queries and pixels must verify the construction; requested poses are not evidence.
"""
ASSET='/Game/Carla/Static/RoadLine/SM_BassicTrafficLineCube_trafficlineCube.SM_BassicTrafficLineCube_trafficlineCube'
# Actual scale1 local bounds from retained mesh-survey-v2. New setup rechecks them.
EXTENT=(.06204589828848839,.06204365938901901,.0038028834387660027)
CENTER=(.061835937201976776,0,2.38418573772492e-09)
SCALE=.35/(2*EXTENT[1])

def spawn(carla,world):
 import json
 from pathlib import Path
 cfg=json.loads(Path(__file__).with_name('config.json').read_text())
 if cfg['reference_kind'] in ('sight','unmarked_crosswalk'):return []
 bp=world.get_blueprint_library().find('static.prop.mesh')
 bp.set_attribute('mesh_path',ASSET);bp.set_attribute('scale',str(SCALE));bp.set_attribute('mass','0');actors=[]
 for side,x,sign in [('west',cfg['reference_x_m'],1),('east',-cfg['reference_x_m'],-1)]:
  base_x=x
  for i in range(40 if cfg['reference_kind']=='marked_crosswalk' else 20):
   y=sign*(.175+.35*(i%20));x=base_x+(1.2*(i//20) if cfg['reference_kind']=='marked_crosswalk' else 0);bp.set_attribute('role_name','stop257_'+side+'_physical_stopline_tile_%02d'%i)
   pose=carla.Transform(carla.Location(x=x-CENTER[0],y=y,z=.002-EXTENT[2]*SCALE-CENTER[2]))
   actor=world.spawn_actor(bp,pose);actor.set_simulate_physics(False);actor.set_collisions(False);actors.append(actor)
 return actors

def observe(actors):
 values=[]
 for actor in actors:
  t=actor.get_transform();b=actor.bounding_box
  values.append({'actor_id':actor.id,'blueprint':actor.type_id,'role':actor.attributes.get('role_name'),'asset':actor.attributes.get('mesh_path'),'scale':actor.attributes.get('scale'),'native_transform':str(t),'native_matrix':t.get_matrix(),'position_m':[t.location.x,t.location.y,t.location.z],'body_vertices_m':[[p.x,p.y,p.z] for p in b.get_world_vertices(t)],'bbox_extent_m':[b.extent.x,b.extent.y,b.extent.z],'bbox_local_center_m':[b.location.x,b.location.y,b.location.z]})
 return values
